verdict.rationale: Xero markets core financial reporting/dashboards (KPIs, cash flow trends, consolidated multi-currency statements) via xero-docs-9, xero-docs-16, xero-docs-17, xero-docs-22, but there is no direct evidence describing on-demand generation of a full P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any arbitrary period with accuracy guarantees, nor independent/hands-on corroboration of report accuracy. missing for 10: explicit documentation of P&L/balance sheet/cash-flow statement generation for custom date ranges, evidence of accuracy/reliability, and independent user corroboration of report correctness.
